sports.headline: MCC dig up 'unsatisfactory' Test pitch after ICC demerit point
sports.hook: Surface used for New Zealand Test in June led to 40 wickets falling in 166 overs
sports.summary: The Marylebone Cricket Club (MCC) has taken action to address the unsatisfactory pitch conditions that led to a demerit point from the International Cricket Council (ICC) following the Test match between England and New Zealand in June 2023. The pitch at the Lord's Cricket Ground resulted in 40 wickets falling in just 166 overs, prompting the ICC to assess it as below standard. As a result, the MCC has decided to dig up the pitch to ensure better conditions for future matches. This decision reflects the MCC's commitment to maintaining high standards in cricket venues and addressing feedback from the ICC.
